decisions.reason: The UV-curing lacquer has not appeared on the website since 2018 and the firm already pruned similar lab consumables in 2019, but it remains a cheap finishing product that fits lab workflows, so keeping it is still the more likely choice.

Custom earmolds are core custom-device manufacturing for hearing-care retailers and benefit from digital production, so the line is more likely to be refined than withdrawn despite its reduced website visibility.

Custom hearing protection uses the same earmold production capabilities and serves growing occupational and end-user demand, so it should be kept even though it has not been observed on the website recently.
